name: future-museum-curator
description: Let the future misread an everyday object, then render the fiction as a museum share card.

interface.longDescription: Reimagine an ordinary object as a fictional artifact from centuries in the future, optionally create a museum scene with the user's own image capability, and render a stable share card locally.
defaultPrompt: What will 3026 think this object was?
Curate this photo in a dryly serious future-museum voice.
Make a warm future-museum share card from this everyday object.
